title: Avomi CLIQ Mini Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The Avomi CLIQ Mini Prefilled Pod Kit offers a streamlined, pocket-friendly evolution of the popular CLIQ system, designed to bridge the gap between single-use disposables and rechargeable vape kits. Ideally suited for vapers seeking a compact device that does not compromise on longevity, the CLIQ Mini utilises a unique hybrid e-liquid system. By combining a standard 2ml prefilled pod with an additional 4ml refill container, this kit provides a total of 6ml of e-liquid. This innovative design allows for extended vaping sessions without the waste associated with traditional single-use devices. Powered by a built-in 850mAh battery, the CLIQ Mini is designed for reliability and all-day performance. It features USB-C fast charging, ensuring that your device is ready whenever you are. The device employs advanced mesh coil technology, which heats e-liquid faster and more evenly than standard wire coils, delivering a consistent Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw that mimics the sensation of a cigarette. The CLIQ Mini is finished with a durable metallic coating and stands at just 12cm tall, making it an ergonomic and discreet option for travel or commuting. Each kit comes preloaded with Avomi’s premium 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid, providing a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Exuding Avomi’s signature quality, the CLIQ Mini offers simplicity, flavour, and performance in one sleek device. Avomi CLIQ Mini Kit Flavours • Blueberry Ice A classic pairing of plump, sweet Blueberries with a crisp, cooling Ice finish. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry Rich Blueberry notes balanced by the sharp, tangy kick of Sour Raspberry. • Cola Ice A vintage-inspired Cola flavour with fizzy notes and a chilled Ice exhale. • Fizzy Cherry Sweet, ripe Cherry combined with a sparkling soda sensation for a fizzy finish. • Lemon & Lime A sharp citrus duo featuring zesty Lemon and bright Lime notes. • Menthol A classic, brisk Menthol profile delivering a clean and refreshing cooling sensation. • Orange Soda Tangy Orange citrus blended with effervescent soda notes for a sweet, refreshing vape. • Pineapple Ice Exotic, tangy Pineapple layered with a breeze of cooling Ice. • Raspberry Blackcurrant A deep berry blend combining tart Raspberry with the dark, woody sweetness of Blackcurrant. • Red Raspberry A pure, single-note Raspberry profile highlighting sweet and tart fruit notes. • Spearmint A mellow mint option offering the sweet, botanical taste of fresh Spearmint. • Strawberry Ice Ripe, garden-fresh Strawberry sweetened and cooled by a layer of Ice. • Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice A complex trio of Strawberry, Raspberry, and Cherry finished with a cooling Ice effect. • Watermelon Ice Fresh, light Watermelon notes enhanced by a crisp, refreshing Ice exhale.
